name: titan-hunter-3d
description: High-speed 3D ODM Aerial Action Game built with Three.js, TypeScript, and Rapier 3D

scripts.docker:build:prod: npm run docker:build:server && npm run docker:build:client
scripts.docker:net: docker network inspect titan-net >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create titan-net
scripts.docker:run:server: npm run docker:net && docker run -d --name titan-hunter-server --network titan-net --restart unless-stopped -p 2567:2567 -e NODE_ENV=production khanhtrn2608/aot-server:prod
scripts.docker:run:client: npm run docker:net && docker run -d --name titan-hunter-client --network titan-net --restart unless-stopped -p 8080:80 -e SERVER_UPSTREAM=titan-hunter-server:2567 khanhtrn2608/aot-client:prod
scripts.docker:run:prod: npm run docker:run:server && npm run docker:run:client
